verdict.rationale: BigQuery documents public programmatic interfaces. These include the Storage Write API (gRPC and REST) for streaming and batch writes, ODBC/JDBC drivers that connect applications to BigQuery features, a Rust SDK in Preview, and Arrow-format query result retrieval. Together these let an AI-native user drive the product in code. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party reference for a general REST API covering query, job and resource management; independent hands-on corroboration of API-driven workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: we recommend using the Storage Write API (gRPC) instead of the Storage Write API (REST)
Puedes usar la API de Storage Write para transmitir registros a BigQuery en tiempo real o procesar por lotes una gran cantidad arbitraria de registros y confirmarlos en una sola operación atómica.

The Simba Open Database Connectivity (ODBC) and Java Database Connectivity (JDBC) drivers for BigQuery connect your applications to BigQuery, letting you use BigQuery features with your preferred tooling and infrastructure.
The Rust SDK for BigQuery is now in Preview.
You can now retrieve query results directly in the Apache Arrow format for faster retrieval speed and improved serialization efficiency.
